info.title: ODYSSEIA Backend API
info.description: Member-only independent forums, threaded/chat topic layouts, persistent fixed chat channels, and direct/group conversations with text, image, and voice attachments. A valid access token bootstraps the local user. Identity groups and per-forum roles expose effective grants for UI gates; the highest-priority role supplies the only grants. Topic and channel writes still follow current forum membership and still require text. Direct conversations require a shared forum at creation. Group membership is separate from forum roles. Conversation events are published to each member's user-limited inbox channel; HTTPS history remains authoritative. Attachment bytes are uploaded through the API and downloaded by a short-lived presigned GET after a membership check. A separate sweep removes objects about 7 days after upload; bound attachments stay on the message with expired set, and download then returns 404. Custom emoji are site-wide or per forum. A forum emoji can be sent only in topics and channels of that same forum. Conversations accept site emoji only. Messages cite them as <:name:id> or <a:name:id>. Bytes live in a public bucket separate from conversation attachments, with a content-hash key and Cache-Control immutable. Deleting an emoji keeps the object and rewrites later reads of that token to :name:. Connection JWTs grant identity only. Author and platform overrides, works, read receipts and production capacity remain separate stages.

post.description: Bodyless authenticated request. Returns an identity-only connection JWT, valid for at most 60 seconds and never beyond the original access token expiration. It contains no channel grants. Subscription authorization is checked independently against current membership, including reconnects.

204.description: Process handles requests; dependencies are not checked.
Database connection is available; not a schema or business readiness guarantee.

503.description: Database connection is unavailable. Empty body.

get.description: Returns the local user for the verified issuer and subject, creating that user on the first valid access token. Tokens in cookies, query parameters and identity headers are ignored. Responses have Cache-Control: no-store. Requires an RFC 9068 JWT access token, typ at+jwt (or application/at+jwt), nonempty kid, iss/aud/sub/exp/iat/jti/client_id, and RS256, ES256 or EdDSA. none and HMAC algorithms are rejected. ID tokens and opaque access tokens are unsupported.

200.description: Current local user. Does not expose external subject, email or token claims.

get.description: Lists the identity-group catalog, including built-in member, moderator and owner roles. Any authenticated user may read it.

200.description: Catalog ordered by ascending priority. Cache-Control: no-store.

put.description: Assigns a catalog group to a local user. Repeated assignment is the same result. The caller needs manage_groups on their highest-priority catalog group. The first owner is inserted by the migration role.

delete.description: Removes a catalog assignment. Removing an assignment that is already absent returns removed=false. Requires manage_groups.

get.description: Lists current forum members and the role stored on each membership. priority and role_name are that stored role, not the caller's effective priority from catalog groups. Non-members receive the same 404 as a missing forum. after is an exclusive user id.

post.description: Adds a local user to the forum. role_id defaults to the built-in member group. Requires manage_members on the caller's winning role. The granted role priority must be strictly below the caller's effective priority in this forum. An existing membership returns 409 member_exists.

409.description: The user is already a member of this forum.

delete.description: Removes a forum member, records the removal and enqueues a realtime disconnect in the same transaction. Requires manage_members. The target's effective priority (highest of catalog groups and the stored forum role) must be strictly below the caller's effective priority. The change is rejected when it would leave the forum with no member whose winning role grants manage_members. The maintenance command remains available for audited operator retries.

put.description: Sets the single role stored on this forum membership. Requires manage_members. The new role, and the member's effective priority, must both be strictly below the caller's effective priority. Effective priority is the highest of catalog groups and the stored forum role, the same value GET permissions returns. Demotion is rejected when the forum would have no remaining manager.

get.description: Returns the caller's winning role in this forum. Applicable roles are the membership role plus catalog assignments. Only the highest-priority role's grants are returned. read, post and delete are UI gates; topic and channel writes remain membership checks. manage_members and manage_groups are enforced on the collaboration routes.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque v1 cursor bound to this resource and collection. This is not an authorization credential.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Scoped by actor and target collection. Exact retries return the original 201 response; changed content returns 409.

201.description: Persisted result, including exact idempotency replays.

post.description: Creates an independent forum topic and its opening message. No work/card resource is required. threaded and chat select the initial topic layout; both use the same canonical messages, optional one-level root ownership, same-topic quotes and live events. Publishing does not provide mode changes or personal view settings. Checks current forum membership before bounded write admission and rechecks it in the transaction after waiting, including idempotency replays. Missing or inaccessible forums return resource_not_found without joining their counter queue. Admission is scoped by forum and then by this API instance's global transaction budget; capacity refusal remains write_capacity_exceeded with Retry-After.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque v1 cursor bound to this resource and collection. This is not an authorization credential.

get.description: Ordered canonical messages for both topic layouts. Scope-bound keyset cursor; current membership is checked before cached content is read. Root ownership is independent of the quoted message.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Scoped by actor and target collection. Exact retries return the original 201 response; changed content returns 409.

201.description: Persisted result, including exact idempotency replays.

post.description: root_id must point to a root entry in this topic; quote_id may point to any message in the same topic. Quoting a child does not create a third level. Author comes from verified identity. Checks current membership before bounded write admission and rechecks it in the transaction after waiting, including idempotency replays. Missing or inaccessible topics return resource_not_found without joining their counter queue. Admission is scoped by message stream and then by this API instance's global transaction budget; capacity refusal remains write_capacity_exceeded with Retry-After. Body and pending publication commit atomically; the outbox delivers publication asynchronously over WSS. HTTPS creation acknowledgement does not confirm receipt by all subscribers.

Bodyless authenticated request. Checks current resource visibility and returns the exact WSS channel, without a channel JWT. Subscribe without a token; the realtime server calls the authenticated subscribe proxy on every subscription and recovery attempt. Connection JWTs do not grant a channel.

200.description: Authorized channel descriptor, Cache-Control: no-store. Subscription is checked again at the realtime server.

post.description: Bodyless authenticated request. Checks current resource visibility and returns the exact WSS channel, without a channel JWT. Subscribe without a token; the realtime server calls the authenticated subscribe proxy on every subscription and recovery attempt. Connection JWTs do not grant a channel.

200.description: Authorized channel descriptor, Cache-Control: no-store. Subscription is checked again at the realtime server.

post.description: Private service-to-service HTTPS callback. Centrifugo supplies the authenticated user and requested channel. Checks the same current resource read permission as HTTPS; client data/meta/labels never grant access. Provider namespaces enable subscribe_proxy_enabled. No channel JWTs or client forwarding of the private credential are configured.

200.description: Protocol response: result accepts; error.code=103 denies. Cache-Control: no-store.

parameters.description: Opaque v1 cursor bound to this resource and collection. This is not an authorization credential.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Scoped by actor and target collection. Exact retries return the original 201 response; changed content returns 409.

201.description: Persisted result, including exact idempotency replays.

post.description: Creates an empty persistent chat channel in an independent forum. Current explicit forum members can create channels in this slice; production creation/management roles remain pending. Checks current membership before the same shared write budget and again in the transaction. Topic/channel creation share one forum event position, so list positions may have gaps. Idempotency is scoped by actor, forum and channel creation; a retry creates no additional stream or event. No work/card or opening message is required.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque v1 cursor bound to this resource and collection. This is not an authorization credential.

get.description: Canonical channel history, in ascending sequence order; starts empty and the first message has sequence 1. The cursor is bound to channel_messages and this channel. Authorization is checked in PostgreSQL on every read, including cache hits. No root_id is returned.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Scoped by actor and target collection. Exact retries return the original 201 response; changed content returns 409.

201.description: Persisted result, including exact idempotency replays.

post.description: Commits one message and one channel.message.created event atomically. quote_id must be in this channel; root_id, author_id and unknown fields are rejected. Uses the same per-stream/global write budget as topics, with current access checked before admission and inside the transaction, including retries. Same key/input returns the original message; changed input returns 409. A 201 confirms persistence, not receipt by every subscriber. Capacity 503 retains Retry-After: 1.

Bodyless request. Returns channel:<canonical UUID> after checking inherited current forum membership. It is a descriptor, never a grant; the subscribe proxy checks membership again for initial subscriptions and recovery. Full-forum removal queues the existing user-wide disconnect, covering all channel subscriptions too.

200.description: Authorized channel descriptor, Cache-Control: no-store. Subscription is checked again at the realtime server.

post.description: Opens a text conversation with user_id. Creating a pair requires a shared forum. If the caller is already an active member, the live pair is returned and a removed peer is not restored. After the caller has left, the same idempotency key returns resource_not_found and does not restore membership. A new key checks the shared forum again and, when it still holds, creates a new conversation; the old row keeps its history for whoever remains. Changed content for the same key returns 409.

200.description: Existing pair created by a different request.

201.description: Created by this idempotency key, including an exact replay.

post.description: Creates a text group. The caller is the only owner. member_ids are other users who each share a forum with the caller; order is not significant. The member ceiling defaults to 50 and can be lowered with ODYSSEIA_CONVERSATION_MEMBER_LIMIT. An exact retry returns the original group only while the caller is still an active member. After removal, that same key returns resource_not_found and does not restore the caller.

201.description: Persisted group, including an exact replay.

get.description: Lists conversations visible to the caller, newest activity first. Activity is the latest message time, or the creation time when the conversation has no messages. The conversations row is not rewritten for each message. The cursor is bound to this caller.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as next. It cannot be used by another user.

200.description: One page. next is absent on the last page.

get.description: Returns one conversation and its active members. Non-members, removed members and dissolved groups receive resource_not_found.

delete.description: Dissolves a group. Only the owner may call it, including when other members remain. Direct conversations are rejected with invalid_input; a participant leaves instead. This is the last-owner action: the owner cannot leave through the member route.

200.description: Group dissolved. Former members subsequently receive resource_not_found.

get.description: Canonical HTTPS history for an active member. New members can read messages from before they joined. Centrifugo inbox history is only a short recovery buffer.

post.description: Appends one conversation message and publishes conversation.message.created to each active member's inbox. body may be empty only when attachment_ids is non-empty. Each id must name a ready attachment uploaded by the caller in this conversation and not yet bound. quote_id must name a message in this conversation. The author's private read cursor advances to the new position; peers do not receive a read receipt. One outbox row is written per active member. The event carries attachment metadata, not a presigned URL. A 201 confirms persistence, not client receipt.

201.description: Persisted message, including an exact replay.

post.description: Streams one image or voice file through the API into private object storage. The caller must be an active member. Content-Type and the filename are not trusted: the server sniffs the bytes, rejects SVG, HTML, and unknown types, strips JPEG/PNG/WebP metadata, and checks image dimensions or voice duration. Voice requires duration_ms. The stored object is ready but unbound until a message references it. This request shares the server's read deadline.

duration_ms.description: Client-reported voice duration. Required for audio and rejected for images. The stored duration is the container duration when it agrees.

201.description: Ready attachment owned by the caller. Location names the download route.

get.description: Active members receive a 302 to a short-lived presigned GET. The URL is a bearer token for one object. An expired attachment, a non-member, a removed member, or an unknown id is 404. History still lists an expired attachment with expired set so the client can show that it existed; this route does not issue a URL for it. Another member can open an attachment only after it is bound to a message; the uploader can open their own ready object before sending. This redirect sets nosniff. The object response carries the allowlisted Content-Type stored with the object; object storage cannot add X-Content-Type-Options.

302.description: Presigned GET. Do not log or persist the Location value.

put.description: Bodyless request. The group owner adds a user who shares a forum with the owner. The new member can read the full history. Adding an active member again returns that membership and does not emit another event. Direct conversations reject additional members.

delete.description: Removes an active member. A group owner cannot remove themselves; transfer ownership first, or dissolve when they are the last owner. That refusal is 409 last_manager. A non-owner cannot remove someone else. Either direct-message participant may leave. The removed user can no longer read or write.

put.description: Transfers the single group owner to an active member. Direct conversations have no owner.

Moves the caller's private cursor forward. An equal or older position leaves the cursor unchanged and emits no event. The event conversation.read is delivered only to the caller's inbox. Other members are not told.

200.description: Cursor after the request. It is never lower than the stored cursor.

get.description: Private unread counts, one row per conversation whose latest position is ahead of the caller's cursor. Counts omit the caller's own messages because sending advances that cursor. Zero-unread conversations are omitted.

200.description: Positive unread rows and their sum.

post.description: Bodyless request. Returns inbox:#<caller UUID>. This is the channel name, not a grant. Centrifugo allows the subscription only when the connection JWT subject equals that UUID and the inbox namespace has allow_user_limited_channels. The subscribe proxy is not consulted for this channel. History on the channel is a short recovery buffer; canonical history is HTTPS.

get.description: Live site emoji, ordered by name. Any authenticated user may list them. Cache-Control: no-store. The image URL is public and immutable.

post.description: Upload one site emoji. Requires Idempotency-Key and a caller listed in ODYSSEIA_EMOJI_SITE_OWNER_IDS. The identity-catalog owner role is a forum role and is not this directory owner. The file is png, apng, gif, or webp. Animation is detected from the container; there is no resize. The object key contains the content hash and is stored in the public emoji bucket, not the conversation bucket.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Scoped by the caller. Exact retries return the original emoji; a different file, name, or scope returns 409.

get.description: One live emoji. A forum emoji is visible only to a current member of that forum. A deleted emoji is not found.

delete.description: Soft-delete a site emoji. The public object is kept because the key is content-addressed. Later message reads rewrite <:name:id> or <a:name:id> to :name:. Requires a directory owner.

get.description: Live emoji for one forum. Non-members receive 404.

post.description: Upload one forum emoji. The caller's effective forum role must be moderator or higher (priority >= 200, which includes owner). Same file rules as site emoji.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Scoped by the caller. Exact retries return the original emoji; a different file, name, or scope returns 409.

delete.description: Soft-delete one emoji that belongs to this forum. Moderator or higher. The object stays in the public bucket.

realtimeProxy.name: X-Odysseia-Proxy-Key
realtimeProxy.description: Private service credential from Centrifugo to this HTTPS proxy. Separate from connection signing. Never forward this header from clients.

token.description: HS256 credential for the configured Centrifugo connection verifier; never log or put in a URL.

expires_at.description: Credential expiration as Unix seconds; does not include Centrifugo grace.

mode.description: Creation-time default layout. Both modes keep the same canonical message order, optional root ownership and same-topic quotes. Mode changes and personal view preferences are not provided.

emojis.description: Custom emoji still available in body, in first-seen order. A deleted emoji is omitted and its token in body is rewritten to :name:.

body.description: Non-whitespace UTF-8 text. Maximum 32768 UTF-8 bytes; NUL is forbidden.

mode.description: Creation-time default layout. Both modes keep the same canonical message order, optional root ownership and same-topic quotes. Mode changes and personal view preferences are not provided.

body.description: Non-whitespace UTF-8 text. Maximum 32768 UTF-8 bytes; NUL is forbidden.

root_id.description: Omit or use null/empty for no reference.

quote_id.description: Omit or use null/empty for no reference.

Channel.description: Persistent chat-only stream. It has no opening message, topic mode or per-channel membership copy. The current explicit-member slice permits forum members to create channels; complete creation/management roles remain pending.

body.description: Non-whitespace UTF-8 text. Maximum 32768 UTF-8 bytes; NUL is forbidden.

quote_id.description: Omit or use null/empty for no reference.

emojis.description: Custom emoji still available in body, in first-seen order. A deleted emoji is omitted and its token in body is rewritten to :name:.

url.description: Stable public URL. The object key contains the content hash. Cache-Control on the object is public, max-age=31536000, immutable.

expired.description: True after the sweep removed the object and kept the message link. Omitted while the object is still available. Download is then 404.

body.description: Required and non-blank when attachment_ids is empty. May be empty when at least one attachment is bound.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid bearer access token. WWW-Authenticate challenge supplied. No token or verifier details returned.

NotProvisioned.description: The configured directory reported no local user. The API process directory creates the user for a valid access token, so a trusted subject does not receive this response.

Unavailable.description: Required dependency unavailable, or a write cannot enter the bounded transaction budget (code write_capacity_exceeded). Capacity refusal provides Retry-After: 1; retry the same command with its original Idempotency-Key, bounded retries and jitter. No resource existence, database or credential details returned.

Retry-After.description: Present on temporary write capacity refusal; seconds before retrying. This is a retry hint, not an availability deadline.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, unknown fields, invalid UUID/header, invalid or cross-scope cursor.

PermissionDenied.description: The caller lacks the required grant, or the role being granted or the target's effective priority is not strictly below the caller's effective priority.

LastManager.description: The group owner must transfer ownership before leaving. The sole owner dissolves the group instead. Code last_manager.

ResourceNotFound.description: Resource is absent or not accessible to this member; identical response.

Conflict.description: The same actor, resource and Idempotency-Key was already used with different parsed content.

TooLarge.description: Request JSON exceeds 256 KiB, or an attachment exceeds the configured byte limit (body_too_large) or the caller's stored quota (upload_quota_exceeded).

UnsupportedMedia.description: The upload bytes are SVG, HTML, or not an allowlisted image or voice container. Code unsupported_media_type.

UploadRate.description: The caller exceeded the per-minute upload count. Code upload_rate_exceeded. Retry-After is 60.

InvalidInput.description: Invalid content, unsupported mode, invalid same-topic root/quote, image dimensions, voice duration, or an attachment that is not ready, owned, in this conversation, and unbound. Third-level nesting is rejected.

InvalidProxyCredential.description: Missing, duplicate or invalid private proxy credential; external Bearer access tokens do not authenticate this endpoint.

Forbidden.description: The caller can see the resource but lacks this management action.
